A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Stable-GFlowNet work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, algorithm, and complete appendices support reliable comparison after matching relocated and renumbered content.

before.justification: V1 reports original red-teaming, transfer-attack, safety fine-tuning, molecular-generation, and noisy-hypergrid results in the main text and Appendix B.

after.justification: V3 retains these original empirical results and adds a comparison with mean- and median-based loss variants in Appendix B.2, Table A.

M1.justification: The proposed CTB objective, Noisy Gradient Pruning, Min-K Fluency Stabilizer, and Algorithm 1 remain unchanged. The new mean and median objectives are comparison variants, not changes to Stable-GFlowNet.

E1.justification: The red-teaming, victim-transfer, classifier-transfer, safety fine-tuning/MMLU, molecular-generation, and noisy-hypergrid coverage is retained. The added loss comparison uses the existing red-teaming setting; the ShieldGemma transfer experiment was already present in v1.

E2.justification: V3 Appendix B.2, Table A adds Mean and Median batch-statistic baselines alongside TB, CTB, and CTB+NGP. Existing comparator sets elsewhere remain unchanged. Newly cited Contrastive Balance is discussed but not added as an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: V3 explicitly places the added loss comparison under the existing Table 1 setup. Reported models, training settings, 1,024-prompt evaluation, five sampled victim responses, ASR/UA metrics, and clustering threshold remain unchanged.

E4.justification: New Appendix B.2 tests whether CTB's pairwise formulation offers benefits beyond removing explicit partition-function estimation, using mean and median controls. Existing stabilizer, connectivity, sensitivity, diversity, and qualitative analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Existing three-trial and uncertainty reporting is retained. The new loss-ablation table reports point estimates, as the earlier loss ablation did, without introducing new run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or statistical procedures.

E6.justification: V3 Table A newly reports Mean at 106 unique attacks and 91.4% ASR, and Median at 110 and 86.7%. Its TB, CTB, and CTB+NGP values repeat v1 Table 3b. Existing benchmark scores, qualitative examples, and plotted results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: V3 adds explicit mathematical definitions of mean- and median-centered comparison objectives in Equations 14–15. Theorem 4.1, Proposition 4.2, their proofs, and the CTB gradient derivation retain the same mathematical substance.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same principal claims about eliminating Z estimation, stabilizing training through NGP and MKS, and achieving diverse, effective, transferable attacks. Their scientific scope is unchanged.

C2.justification: V3 Sections A.4.2 and B.2 newly qualify CTB's advantage: CTB alone is comparable to simpler Z-free alternatives, while its distinctive benefit is attributed to compatibility with NGP. The existing toxic-classifier and single-turn applicability limitations are unchanged.

D1.justification: V3 adds a project-code hyperlink in the abstract, providing access information absent from v1. Existing hyperparameters, replay-buffer rules, hardware, runtime descriptions, and training pseudocode are retained.

R1.justification: V3 adds Da Silva et al. (2024), Embarrassingly Parallel GFlowNets, and explicitly positions CTB as an extension of its Contrastive Balance objective to LLM training in Section A.4.2. This substantially revises the central objective's relationship to prior work, beyond a routine citation addition. The DPO discussion already existed in v1.

P1.justification: V3 makes localized grammar, terminology, heading, and running-header corrections. It reorganizes the existing DPO discussion from A.3.2 into A.4.1 and inserts the new comparison section, while retaining the main narrative structure.

P2.justification: V1's small, side-by-side Table 3a/b becomes larger separate Tables 3 and 4. V3 adds Appendix Table A and improves some equation and page layouts. Existing figures are retained; other appendix tables are principally renumbered or repositioned.

improvement.justification: V3 improves attribution by acknowledging Contrastive Balance and adds useful controls that clarify CTB's contribution relative to simpler Z-free objectives. The code pointer and clearer ablation tables also help. These are bounded gains: the main method and validation remain unchanged, and the new comparison provides point estimates without uncertainty estimates.
